selection: The author selected these endpoints and overall tests after reviewing the earlier pairwise comparisons.
unit_of_analysis: One observed cumulative C-stock total per core; three cores per field or margin.
intervals: Group summaries retain distinct SD and SE columns. Profile figure error bars use one SE.
multiplicity: One overall test per system, without pairwise contrasts or Holm adjustment in this module.
historical_module: analysis/stock_endpoints_2026-10-20 remains unchanged as the earlier pairwise endpoint analysis.
portable_adapter: The script reads the exact 21 selected core observations, rather than reselecting them from the earlier 30-row endpoint table. It uses the same Welch ANOVA and group-summary calculations.
